name: Corbin's Corner
summary: Corbin's Corner is a thriving 194,880 square foot community center in West Hartford's premier retail corridor, featuring top-tier anchors including BEST BUY, TRADER JOE'S, and TOTAL WINE. With over 4.1 million annual visits, the center serves one of Connecticut's most affluent markets near Westfarms Mall.
demographics: Corbin's Corner attracts an affluent, educated demographic from West Hartford and surrounding communities, with median household incomes significantly above the national average. The primary trade area consists of families and professionals aged 35-65, with a strong presence of dual-income households and college-educated residents. The center draws over 4.1 million annual visits from shoppers seeking quality groceries, home improvement, fitness, and specialty retail in one of Connecticut's most desirable suburban markets. The location benefits from West Hartford's reputation as a premier residential community with high disposable income and strong retail spending patterns.
description: Corbin's Corner is a premier community shopping center located at 1445 New Britain Avenue in the heart of West Hartford, Connecticut's thriving retail corridor. Strategically positioned near the renowned Westfarms Mall in an area with high barriers to entry, this 194,880 square foot center serves as a vital shopping destination for one of Connecticut's most affluent communities. The center features an impressive lineup of best-in-class merchants including BEST BUY, TRADER JOE'S, THE EDGE FITNESS CLUBS, THE TILE SHOP, OLD NAVY, and TOTAL WINE AND MORE, offering a compelling mix of grocery, fitness, home improvement, and specialty retail options. With over 4.1 million annual visits, Corbin's Corner has established itself as a go-to destination for discerning shoppers seeking quality and convenience. Managed by Regency Centers, a leader in developing thriving retail centers nationwide, the property benefits from professional management and a commitment to maintaining a vibrant tenant mix that serves the community's evolving needs.
